name: Drumming Well Lane

layers.essential_history: [[c:The Drumming Well was in a yard by the Talbot. People said it made a drumming sound before something terrible happened. The lane here is named after it.]]
layers.deeper_history: [[c:Stories of the well were told for centuries, and a room at the Talbot is named after it.]]
layers.mystery: [[c:By the lane, the schoolboy Tom Crane admits he crept out to hear the well drum. He says he heard more than drumming.]]

puzzle.title: [[c:What Tom heard]]
puzzle.intro: [[c:Read the first letter of each line.]]
puzzle.question: [[c:Where did the footsteps go? (one word)]]
hints: [[c:It's the tallest part of a church.]]
puzzle.reveal: [[c:The first letters spell TOWER. Someone carried something heavy towards the church tower.]]
puzzle.fallback: [[c:Stuck? Take a hint: hints are free.]]

evidence: [[c:Tom heard heavy footsteps heading for the church tower at midnight.]]
directions_to_next: [[c:Head north-west, about 200 metres as the crow flies, to Oundle School Chapel.  Keep to pavements and public paths.]]
